audit_items.proof_trace: The nested loop retrieves data columns individually per (block, index) pair. Missing columns are silently skipped (L1229: Ok(None) => {} no-op) instead of enforcing all-or-nothing. This violates the invariant that all sidecars must be sent if any sidecar is sent.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Block B has columns [0,1] available but column 2 missing due to storage inconsistency. Peer requests columns [0,1,2]. Node sends 0 and 1, silently skips 2, violating completeness invariant and breaking reconstruction protocols.
